description: This file defines the amd64-specific stack walker class 'StackwalkerAMD64' for the Google Breakpad crash reporting system. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and references to external components related to stack unwinding and frame analysis on amd64 architecture.

classes.name: StackwalkerAMD64
classes.description: A class implementing amd64-specific stack unwinding logic, including methods for retrieving caller frames using CFI, frame pointers, and stack scanning.

methods.name: StackwalkerAMD64
methods.description: Constructor initializing the amd64 stack walker with system info, context, memory, modules, and symbolizer.

methods.name: GetContextFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the current stack frame based on the amd64 context.

methods.name: GetCallerFrame
methods.description: Determines the caller's stack frame from the current call stack, with optional stack scanning.

methods.name: GetCallerByCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Constructs the caller frame using CFI frame information.

methods.name: IsEndOfStack
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stack has been reached based on instruction addresses and stack pointers.

methods.name: GetCallerByFramePointerRecovery
methods.description: Recovers the caller frame assuming traditional frame layout using frame pointers.

methods.name: GetCallerByStackScan
methods.description: Scans the stack for plausible return addresses to find the caller frame.
